name: Kimpton EPIC Miami
insider_take: This sleek waterfront tower puts you in the heart of downtown Miami's financial district with sweeping Biscayne Bay views and yacht-dotted marina access.
whats_special: The EPIC features Miami's only rooftop pool overlooking the bay, plus the hotel sits directly on the Miami River with its own marina. The 31st-floor Area 31 restaurant sources seafood from a 31-mile radius, while the lobby's living wall contains over 7,000 plants creating a stunning vertical garden.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on floors 20+ for unobstructed sunrise views over Biscayne Bay and Key Biscayne. The hotel's water taxi service can whisk you to South Beach in just 15 minutes.
dont_miss: Sunset cocktails at the 16th-floor pool deck, exploring the adjacent Riverwalk's sculpture installations, and the Saturday morning farmers market at Bayfront Park just two blocks away. The hotel's resident artist program features rotating local Miami talent in the lobby galleries.
pros: Prime downtown Miami location with Biscayne Bay waterfront access
Spacious suites and condos with floor-to-ceiling windows and bay views
Rooftop pool deck and multiple dining venues including Area 31 restaurant
Modern luxury amenities with Kimpton's signature boutique hospitality
cons: Urban downtown setting may lack beach resort atmosphere
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and prime location
